environment: One in-app browser tab, 402x874 viewport. Simulator was not running; these are not physical iPhone measurements.
changes: Immutable maximum-preview-density static scene tiles share one parent mapping; no per-object rerasterization during static preview zoom.
Sixteen-pixel source guards and outer-edge extrusion prevent transparent sampling at photo/mask/page boundaries. Cache is capped at 256 MiB and never silently downsampled.
Photo-edit GPU surfaces are hidden when leaving base-photo editing so stale complete scenes cannot cover live shape glow.
Remove shape opacity controls in both editors without rewriting existing saved object alpha.
Selection bounds and live line/grid painters use identical continuous stroke-width geometry.
limitations: Raster ink-bound samples fluctuate by roughly one sampling pixel; the immutable scene transform itself is shared exactly. This is not a claim of identical pixel colours at different zooms.

A legacy strict boundary-colour test rejects legitimate filtered transitions from 24-gray photos to a black mask. The new whole-scene test checks opacity and foreign colours instead, excluding only the saturated green marker's Display-P3 anti-aliased rim.
Snapshots apply to static, unselected scenes. Editing, animations and video retain the live painter; exports retain their original rendering route.
Preparing a new scene snapshot is bounded background work, not a guarantee of zero work immediately after every edit or of 60 fps on every iPhone.
Process RSS is an observation, not control over all macOS applications or compressed memory.
